description: Localisation et occupation des stations de vélos en libre-service VELHOP is a dataset listed in Plateforme Open Data Ville et Eurométropole de Strasbourg, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville et eurométropole de Strasbourg. Liste des stations de vélos en libre-service Velhop avec leur localisation et la disponibilité des vélos en temps réel. Coverage: Strasbourg Eurométropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transports. Its keywords are gbfs, velhop, Strasbourg. The portal shows 40 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-strasbourg-eu-portal.
